verdict.rationale: Convex documents its own background-automation primitives: a scheduler for running background workflows, Crons included on every plan, and "workflow" listed as a core platform capability. These directly let users set up automations that run autonomously server-side. The evidence is limited to brief marketing and llms.txt mentions, so missing for 10: in-depth scheduler/cron documentation (scheduling syntax, retries, durability guarantees), independent or hands-on corroboration.
